title.en: Call a lead and log how it went
title.hi: Lead ko call karo, result log karo
title.mr: Lead la call kara, result log kara

description.en: Call leads from Sales X-Ray in one tap and log every call in seconds: To call, one-tap Call on the Board, How did it go after the call, what happens next, a quick note, and Start calling to go lead after lead.
description.hi: Sales X-Ray se ek tap mein leads ko call kijiye aur har call seconds mein log kijiye: To call, Board pe one-tap Call, call ke baad How did it go, aage kya hoga, chhota note, aur Start calling se ek ke baad ek lead.
description.mr: Sales X-Ray madhun eka tap madhye leads na call kara aani pratyek call kahi seconds madhye log kara: To call, Board var one-tap Call, call nantar How did it go, pudhe kay honar, chhoti note, aani Start calling ne ek nantar ek lead.

names.Can I show you in 10 minutes how: Can I quickly show you how

say.en: In this video: calling a lead in one tap, and logging how the call went, in seconds.
say.hi: इस video में: एक tap में lead को call करना, और call कैसा रहा, वो seconds में log करना.
say.mr: या video मध्ये: एका tap मध्ये lead ला call करणं, आणि call कसा झाला, ते काही seconds मध्ये log करणं.

latn.hi: Is video mein: ek tap mein lead ko call karna, aur call kaisa raha, woh seconds mein log karna.
latn.mr: Ya video madhye: eka tap madhye lead la call karna, aani call kasa jhala, te kahi seconds madhye log karna.

say.en: Next: the Board, and the nine lead stages.
say.hi: अगले video में: Board, और lead के नौ stages.
say.mr: पुढच्या video मध्ये: Board, आणि lead चे नऊ stages.

latn.hi: Agle video mein: Board, aur lead ke nau stages.
latn.mr: Pudhchya video madhye: Board, aani lead che nau stages.

say.en: Log every call in two taps. Here's how.
say.hi: हर call दो tap में log कीजिए. देखिए कैसे.
say.mr: प्रत्येक call दोन tap मध्ये log करा. बघा कसं.

latn.hi: Har call do tap mein log kijiye. Dekhiye kaise.
latn.mr: Pratyek call don tap madhye log kara. Bagha kasa.

say.en: Everything starts in Leads. To call is today's list, with late follow-ups on top.
say.hi: सब कुछ Leads से शुरू होता है. To call में आज की list है, late follow-ups सबसे ऊपर.
say.mr: सगळं Leads पासून सुरू होतं. To call मध्ये आजची list आहे, late follow-ups सगळ्यात वर.

latn.hi: Sab kuch Leads se shuru hota hai. To call mein aaj ki list hai, late follow-ups sabse upar.
latn.mr: Sagla Leads pasun suru hota. To call madhye aajchi list aahe, late follow-ups saglyat var.

say.en: Overdue ones come first, then the people to call right now, then later today.
say.hi: पहले overdue वाले, फिर जिन्हें अभी call करना है, फिर आज बाद में.
say.mr: आधी overdue वाले, मग ज्यांना आत्ता call करायचाय, मग आज नंतर.

latn.hi: Pehle overdue wale, phir jinhe abhi call karna hai, phir aaj baad mein.
latn.mr: Aadhi overdue vale, mag jyanna aatta call karaychay, mag aaj nantar.

say.en: A shortcut: swipe a lead right to call, or left to WhatsApp.
say.hi: एक shortcut: lead को right swipe करो तो call, left swipe करो तो WhatsApp.
say.mr: एक shortcut: lead ला right swipe केलं की call, left swipe केलं की WhatsApp.

latn.hi: Ek shortcut: lead ko right swipe karo toh call, left swipe karo toh WhatsApp.
latn.mr: Ek shortcut: lead la right swipe kela ki call, left swipe kela ki WhatsApp.

say.en: On the Board, every card has a phone button. One tap, and your phone dials.
say.hi: Board पे हर card पे phone का button है. एक tap, और phone number लगा देता है.
say.mr: Board वर प्रत्येक card वर phone चं button आहे. एक tap, आणि phone number लावतो.

latn.hi: Board pe har card pe phone ka button hai. Ek tap, aur phone number laga deta hai.
latn.mr: Board var pratyek card var phone cha button aahe. Ek tap, aani phone number laavto.

say.en: One tap to call, right from the Board.
say.hi: Board से ही, एक tap में call.
say.mr: Board वरूनच, एका tap मध्ये call.

latn.hi: Board se hi, ek tap mein call.
latn.mr: Board varunach, eka tap madhye call.

say.en: Or open a lead and tap Call. Your phone dials straight away.
say.hi: या lead खोलिए और Call दबाइए. Phone तुरंत number लगा देता है.
say.mr: किंवा lead उघडा आणि Call दाबा. Phone लगेच number लावतो.

latn.hi: Ya lead kholiye aur Call dabaiye. Phone turant number laga deta hai.
latn.mr: Kinva lead ughda aani Call daba. Phone lagech number laavto.

say.en: Rather send a message? WhatsApp and SMS are right next to Call.
say.hi: Message भेजना है? WhatsApp और SMS, Call के बगल में ही हैं.
say.mr: Message पाठवायचाय? WhatsApp आणि SMS, Call च्या बाजूलाच आहेत.

latn.hi: Message bhejna hai? WhatsApp aur SMS, Call ke bagal mein hi hain.
latn.mr: Message pathvaychay? WhatsApp aani SMS, Call chya bajulach aahet.

say.en: Back from the call, Sales X-Ray asks how it went.
say.hi: Call से वापस आते ही Sales X-Ray पूछता है, call कैसा रहा.
say.mr: Call वरून परत आल्यावर Sales X-Ray विचारतो, call कसा झाला.

latn.hi: Call se wapas aate hi Sales X-Ray poochta hai, call kaisa raha.
latn.mr: Call varun parat aalyavar Sales X-Ray vichaarto, call kasa jhala.

say.en: Back from a call? It asks how it went.
say.hi: Call से वापस? ये पूछता है कैसा रहा.
say.mr: Call वरून परत? हा विचारतो कसा झाला.

latn.hi: Call se wapas? Yeh poochta hai kaisa raha.
latn.mr: Call varun parat? Ha vichaarto kasa jhala.

say.en: If they didn't pick up, it's No answer, or Didn't get through.
say.hi: Phone नहीं उठाया, तो No answer, या Didn't get through.
say.mr: Phone उचलला नाही, तर No answer, किंवा Didn't get through.

latn.hi: Phone nahi uthaya, toh No answer, ya Didn't get through.
latn.mr: Phone uchalla nahi, tar No answer, kinva Didn't get through.

say.en: Pick what happened. Here, we talked.
say.hi: जो हुआ वो चुनिए. यहाँ बात हो गई.
say.mr: जे झालं ते निवडा. इथे बोलणं झालं.

latn.hi: Jo hua woh chuniye. Yahan baat ho gayi.
latn.mr: Je jhala te nivda. Ithe bolna jhala.

say.en: Then what happens next. Say they agreed to visit: Site visit booked.
say.hi: फिर आगे क्या होगा. मान लो वो visit के लिए ready हैं: Site visit booked.
say.mr: मग पुढे काय होणार. समजा ते visit ला तयार आहेत: Site visit booked.

latn.hi: Phir aage kya hoga. Maan lo woh visit ke liye ready hain: Site visit booked.
latn.mr: Mag pudhe kay honar. Samja te visit la tayar aahet: Site visit booked.

say.en: Then, what happens next.
say.hi: फिर, आगे क्या होगा.
say.mr: मग, पुढे काय होणार.

latn.hi: Phir, aage kya hoga.
latn.mr: Mag, pudhe kay honar.

say.en: Other choices: Call back, Booked when they buy, or Not interested. Then pick when to follow up, like tomorrow morning.
say.hi: बाकी options: Call back, खरीद लिया तो Booked, या Not interested. फिर follow-up कब, वो चुनिए, जैसे tomorrow morning.
say.mr: बाकीचे options: Call back, घेतलं तर Booked, किंवा Not interested. मग follow-up कधी, ते निवडा, जसं tomorrow morning.

latn.hi: Baaki options: Call back, kharid liya toh Booked, ya Not interested. Phir follow-up kab, woh chuniye, jaise tomorrow morning.
latn.mr: Baakiche options: Call back, ghetla tar Booked, kinva Not interested. Mag follow-up kadhi, te nivda, jasa tomorrow morning.

target.placeholder: What they need, what you promised

actions.text: Wants a 2 BHK near Baner. Visit on Sunday morning.

say.en: Add a quick note: what they need, and what you promised.
say.hi: एक छोटा सा note लिख दीजिए: उन्हें क्या चाहिए, और आपने क्या promise किया.
say.mr: एक छोटी note लिहा: त्यांना काय हवंय, आणि तुम्ही काय promise केलं.

latn.hi: Ek chhota sa note likh dijiye: unhe kya chahiye, aur aapne kya promise kiya.
latn.mr: Ek chhoti note liha: tyanna kay havay, aani tumhi kay promise kela.

say.en: Add a quick note.
say.hi: एक छोटा note.
say.mr: एक छोटी note.

latn.hi: Ek chhota note.
latn.mr: Ek chhoti note.

say.en: Tap Save, and it's on their timeline for your next call.
say.hi: Save दबाइए, अगले call के लिए सब उनकी timeline पे रहेगा.
say.mr: Save दाबा, पुढच्या call साठी सगळं त्यांच्या timeline वर राहील.

latn.hi: Save dabaiye, agle call ke liye sab unki timeline pe rahega.
latn.mr: Save daba, pudhchya call saathi sagla tyanchya timeline var raahil.

say.en: Save. Done.
say.hi: Save. हो गया.
say.mr: Save. झालं.

latn.hi: Save. Ho gaya.
latn.mr: Save. Jhala.

say.en: No call, just a thought? Tap Add a note, any time.
say.hi: Call नहीं, बस कुछ याद रखना है? कभी भी Add a note दबाइए.
say.mr: Call नाही, फक्त काही लक्षात ठेवायचंय? कधीही Add a note दाबा.

latn.hi: Call nahi, bas kuch yaad rakhna hai? Kabhi bhi Add a note dabaiye.
latn.mr: Call nahi, fakta kahi lakshat thevaychay? Kadhihi Add a note daba.

say.en: Further down, the lead's History keeps everything in one timeline: calls, stage changes, notes and chats.
say.hi: नीचे, lead की History में सब एक ही timeline में है: calls, stage changes, notes और chats.
say.mr: खाली, lead च्या History मध्ये सगळं एकाच timeline मध्ये आहे: calls, stage changes, notes आणि chats.

latn.hi: Neeche, lead ki History mein sab ek hi timeline mein hai: calls, stage changes, notes aur chats.
latn.mr: Khali, lead chya History madhye sagla ekach timeline madhye aahe: calls, stage changes, notes aani chats.

say.en: Filter it to just stages, meetings or notes.
say.hi: चाहें तो सिर्फ stages, meetings या notes देखिए.
say.mr: हवं तर फक्त stages, meetings किंवा notes बघा.

latn.hi: Chahein toh sirf stages, meetings ya notes dekhiye.
latn.mr: Hava tar fakta stages, meetings kinva notes bagha.

say.en: And open any call's Report, straight from here.
say.hi: और किसी भी call की Report यहीं से खोलिए.
say.mr: आणि कुठल्याही call ची Report इथूनच उघडा.

latn.hi: Aur kisi bhi call ki Report yahin se kholiye.
latn.mr: Aani kuthlyahi call chi Report ithunach ughda.

say.en: With Start calling, you go lead after lead. Back from each call, log it right here.
say.hi: Start calling से आप एक के बाद एक lead पे जाते हैं. हर call के बाद यहीं log कीजिए.
say.mr: Start calling ने तुम्ही एक नंतर एक lead वर जाता. प्रत्येक call नंतर इथेच log करा.

latn.hi: Start calling se aap ek ke baad ek lead pe jaate hain. Har call ke baad yahin log kijiye.
latn.mr: Start calling ne tumhi ek nantar ek lead var jaata. Pratyek call nantar ithech log kara.

say.en: No answer? Tap it, and add a note for the next try if you like.
say.hi: Phone नहीं उठाया? No answer दबाइए, और चाहें तो अगली बार के लिए note लिखिए.
say.mr: Phone उचलला नाही? No answer दाबा, आणि हवं तर पुढच्या वेळेसाठी note लिहा.

latn.hi: Phone nahi uthaya? No answer dabaiye, aur chahein toh agli baar ke liye note likhiye.
latn.mr: Phone uchalla nahi? No answer daba, aani hava tar pudhchya velesaathi note liha.

say.en: Then Save and call the next lead, without leaving this screen.
say.hi: फिर Save and call, और अगला lead, इसी screen से.
say.mr: मग Save and call, आणि पुढचा lead, याच screen वरून.

latn.hi: Phir Save and call, aur agla lead, isi screen se.
latn.mr: Mag Save and call, aani pudhcha lead, yach screen varun.

say.en: Save and call the next one.
say.hi: Save करके अगले को call.
say.mr: Save करून पुढच्याला call.

latn.hi: Save karke agle ko call.
latn.mr: Save karun pudhchyala call.

say.en: For outreach lists, the calling desk brings up the next lead, with the best time to reach them.
say.hi: Outreach lists के लिए calling desk अगला lead सामने लाता है, call करने का best time भी.
say.mr: Outreach lists साठी calling desk पुढचा lead समोर आणतो, call करायची best वेळ पण.

latn.hi: Outreach lists ke liye calling desk agla lead saamne laata hai, call karne ka best time bhi.
latn.mr: Outreach lists saathi calling desk pudhcha lead samor aanto, call karaychi best vel pan.

say.en: Your opener is right there, with answers ready for whatever they say.
say.hi: आपका opener यहीं है, और वो जो भी बोलें, उसके जवाब भी ready हैं.
say.mr: तुमचा opener इथेच आहे, आणि ते जे काही बोलतील, त्याची उत्तरं पण ready आहेत.

latn.hi: Aapka opener yahin hai, aur woh jo bhi bolein, uske jawaab bhi ready hain.
latn.mr: Tumcha opener ithech aahe, aani te je kahi boltil, tyachi uttara pan ready aahet.

say.en: Call, log, next. That's the whole routine.
say.hi: Call, log, next. बस, इतना ही.
say.mr: Call, log, next. बस, एवढंच.

latn.hi: Call, log, next. Bas, itna hi.
latn.mr: Call, log, next. Bas, evdhach.
